Temporary development release of Bruce with the optional `bruce-remote/1`
serial extension used by the Android controller.

Assets:

- `Bruce-Remote-cardputer-adv.bin`: merged offset-0 image for both the regular
  Cardputer and Cardputer ADV.
- `Bruce-Remote-m5stickc-plus2.bin`: merged offset-0 image for M5StickC Plus2.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for both images.

This is not an official Bruce release. Confirm the target model and back up
important device data before flashing. The complete corresponding modified
source is the repository at this release tag.
